description: Shared pHloat upload contract. v2 is what the pHloat hub (tiltpi/) accepts; v1 payloads are still valid v2. An upload must carry at least one reading or a settings check-in. GoogleAppsScript.js still implements v1 only.

google_apps_script.notes: v1 only. Deploy GoogleAppsScript.js as a web app (Execute as: Me, Anyone). Set PHLOAT_UPLOAD_SECRET in Script Properties.

hub.notes: Both paths are the same handler. Set upload_secret in config.json or PHLOAT_UPLOAD_SECRET env var. HTTP allowed on the local network; never expose to the internet.

payload.pH: number or decimal string 0-14 (optional in v2)
payload.sg: number, specific gravity read from the Tilt (optional, v2)
payload.tiltColor: colour name or UUID byte such as "0x10" (optional, v2)
payload.tiltTemp: number, degF as the Tilt reports it (optional, v2; not stored, temperature carries it)
payload.metrics: object of {metric_name: number} for anything else, names [a-z][a-z0-9_]* (optional, v2)
payload.timestamp: ISO-8601 (optional; the hub's clock is used when absent)
payload.settings: object of a controller's current settings, e.g. {"target_c": 19, "mode": "auto"} (optional, v2; names and ranges in tiltpi/controller_settings.py)
payload.status: string, a controller's one-line status, at most 80 characters (optional, v2)

response.settings: object: the settings the hub wants the controller to run (hub; empty unless settings were sent)
